description: ENERGY STAR ProductFinder lets users compare ENERGY STAR certified products and find rebates, and the same data are published as about 90 datasets on data.energystar.gov, the EPA's Socrata open data portal, with CSV and JSON export and an API. Datasets cover heat pumps (air-source, ducted, mini-split and geothermal), central and room air conditioners, furnaces, boilers, water heaters including heat pump and solar units, smart thermostats, ventilating fans, insulation, storm windows, appliances, commercial kitchen equipment, lighting, displays, computers, servers and data centre storage, uninterruptible power supplies and electric vehicle chargers, plus Most Efficient and tax-credit eligible lists. The ENERGY STAR Model Index lists all currently certified models across categories with IDs, partners, brands and model numbers, and on 26 September 2026 held about 1.8 million rows; most datasets were updated on 25 September 2026. Coverage: products certified for the U.S. market. Access: free web tool, downloads and API. Licence: EPA Data License; free. Caveats: only certified models appear, and fields differ by product specification version. Simulation uses are efficiency and capacity inputs for equipment in building energy and retrofit models. Related records: the AHRI Directory and EPREL.
